criteria.distance_method: Dense vertices at <=0.005 degree; spherical distance *0.994 -0.4 km. Marine/coastal grid centers: subtract additional 16 km for cell radius.
criteria.footprint: Complete 360x360, +/-2 degrees; no coastline/coastal-zone intersection, no radioclimatic Sea=1, all clutter codes 1..17, no terrain nodata or nonfinite elevation after bilinear resampling.
criteria.selection_method: Keep 39 valid previous stations fixed. Fill 9 vacancies by farthest-first; improve only replacements by single swaps, maximizing minimum regional spacing with pair-sum tie-break.
criteria.height_exception: Mantido o limiar de 55 m no Nordeste para favorecer a distribuição geográfica, com nove alturas abaixo de 70 m. Nas outras três regiões o limiar é 70 m. Todas as alturas são as cadastradas, sem alteração artificial.
criteria.limitation: Distances refer to local cartographic bases, not surveyed coastline. Regional sample is restricted to inland stations; inland water remains included.

revision.reason: Replace stations with terrain nodata; retain all valid stations outside Sul.
